families.signature: Private browser overlays selected captions on a frozen video pair before embedded rendering of that pair. families.reason: Overlay plus immutable inputs is the archived mechanism with binding. Component comparisons alone do not establish a distinct handoff interaction.

families.signature: Editor rehearses changed caption intervals with surrounding motion through a private overlay before requesting full embedded playback. families.reason: Local novelty is changed-cue inspection and its context-sufficiency discriminator, beyond merely adjusting overlay timing or naming it audition.

families.signature: Service uses immutable manifest/generation identity both to replace unstarted requests and gate which completion may become current; delivered assets remain separately pinned. During bursts and reversed completions, fewer obsolete dispatches coexist with rejection of stale current-pointer updates. Requires pending overlap and affordable queue/publication changes.
families.reason: The common identity governing dispatch and publication adds a stale-current eligibility invariant absent from the archive. Familiar constituents and factorial comparisons alone would not suffice; superadditivity is unproved.

families.signature: Editor saves drafts immediately but explicitly requests a full preview, optionally seeing draft/request differences. Consolidated saves reduce renders; timely correct identification improves only if avoided work causes waiting and extra request friction is tolerable. Requires a bounded workflow trial and retained delivery/history.
families.reason: Explicit-request rendering is directly archived; draft-difference display does not establish another causal family.

families.signature: Analyst crosses interruption with a persistent cut/caption-excerpt receipt while holding labels, waits and completion order fixed. Selective reduction of interruption-related selection time/errors would support restoration of remembered intent. Requires bounded counterbalanced tasks; two editors provide exploratory evidence.
families.reason: The interruption-by-receipt discriminator tests intent continuity beyond identifying accurately labeled versions.

limits: All observations are stipulated synthetic data. No actual-world outcome, implementation feasibility, festival capacity or 30-session improvement was measured.
Novelty is relative to the incomplete frozen archive. F05, F06 and F08 are assessable local openings, not established discoveries or proven interactions.

Fit judges the proposed next action: explicit timeboxes, resource stops or fallback can preserve constraints without guaranteeing a completed capability. Necessary unestimated implementation or resource dependencies remain uncertain. No hard premise is explicitly relaxed.
Every raw opening has a direct outcome/decision link and a specific discriminator; equal usefulness/observability scores do not imply equal merit, novelty, validity or empirical support.

All 46 raw openings remain intelligibly represented. Merged and exploratory dispositions are retained; representation is not a recommendation to deploy. No Distill-only family or unsupported new addition was identified.

Post-Distill decisions preserve uncertainty and shared limits; no definite hard-constraint violation or unresolved fit asserted as established usable capability was identified. P010 D1 uses Conditional without actually relaxing a premise.
P005 A2 and D4 overstate what unchanged delays would identify: a failed or inadequate rehearsal could also explain a null benefit. That limitation originated in raw content.
No defensible method identity was recorded. Family assignment followed operations, causal relations and discriminators rather than packet labels.
